# implement-spec run ledger — P0.05 Boundary hooks (`packages/hooks`)

- **Spec:** docs/tickets/05_P0.05__boundary-hooks.md (spec §12.6, §12.2 judge-class, §11.3, §12.10)
- **Base commit:** 4f96c785400a9b8d7c0837e8ea38c61e10f1e491 (P0.04)
- **Branch:** stevevitali/p0-05-boundary-hooks (stacked on P0.04)
- **Package:** packages/hooks (@rhema/hooks; currently a P0.01 skeleton)

## Requirements (from ticket + §12.6/§12.2)
- REQ-DATA-11 — PreToolUse hook classifies every path, denies out-of-namespace + read-only writes, logs every decision; 3 denials of one path abort the step.
- REQ-DATA-12 — Hook inherited by subagents; subagent roster/attribution from data (agent_id).
- REQ-DATA-13 — Allowed-path set appended to every subagent prompt (belt & braces).
- REQ-DATA-15 (hook half) — Per-run URL policy (hold-outs, exclusions, calibrator allow-after-prediction) applied in the hook; denials logged with reason; builder/calibrator server-side web_fetch disabled.
- REQ-DATA-16 — fetch-log join interface (write interface for fetch_log rows).
- REQ-ARCH-17 — one hook package for all seats/engines; policy is data.
- REQ-ARCH-18 — every path/URL tool call audited, append-only, 90 days.
- REQ-OBJ-10 (hook half) — preferences.md never readable by Editor-seat policy.
- REQ-SPEC-13 (part) / §12.2 — judge-class phases reject `Agent`.
- Denial thresholds: 3 denials of one path → abort `failed(boundary)`; >20 denials in a phase → `run.hiccup` + one guided retry.

## Acceptance criteria (deterministic)
- AC1 Policy suite green over every §12.6 seat table row (allow + deny).
- AC2 Symlink/`..`/Bash-argv escape attempts denied (fixture suite).
- AC3 Hold-out URL fetch denied for persona builder; allowed for calibrator only when prediction-file precondition flag set.
- AC4 `Agent` tool call rejected when the phase's manifest row is judge-class.
- AC5 3rd denial of one path → abort signal; 21st denial in a phase → hiccup signal.
- AC6 Every decision (allow + deny) produces an audit row with tool, path, namespace, decision.

## Out of scope
- Mount materialization (P0.09); kernel read-only mounts (P0.06 image).
- Proxy URL enforcement (P0.07).
- Orchestrator reactions to denial counts (P0.08) — hook returns the signal data only.

## Cross-cutting invariants
- Enforced not advised: `disallowedTools` cosmetic; this hook is enforcement.
- Editor↔Drafter wall + persona hold-out: no policy shortcut widens them.

## Plan / module layout (Phase 1)
- src/namespaces.ts — Namespace tokens + §12.6 seat mount tables as data + compileSeatPolicy.
- src/paths.ts — realpath/`..` containment, glob match, Bash argv tokenization, recursive-over-root, classification.
- src/url-policy.ts — URL normalize + hold-out/exclusion/calibrator eval.
- src/audit.ts — access_log/fetch_log row types + buffered append-only writer interface + 90-day retention doc.
- src/denials.ts — per-path (→abort@3) + per-phase (→hiccup@>20) tracker + signals.
- src/hook.ts — PreToolUse evaluator tying it together.
- src/subagents.ts — rendered allowed-path set (REQ-DATA-13) + attribution.
- src/index.ts — re-exports.

## Test matrix (Phase 1.4)
- seat-tables.test.ts — AC1: table-driven over every §12.6 seat×path-class×tool (allow+deny); Editor wall (agents/author, voice-print/lexicon/exemplars, preferences.md); assistant exemplars+frozen ledgers; persona_builder profile rw/docs ro; system none.
- paths.test.ts — AC2: symlink escape (fake resolver), `..` escape, Bash-argv escape; glob forms; normalizePosix; recursive-over-root (Glob/Grep/Bash); tokenizeBash.
- url-policy.test.ts — AC3: hold-out deny for builder; calibrator allow iff predictionFileWritten+isCalibrator+in allow; serverFetchDisabled; userExclusions; blockedDomains; normalizeUrl.
- hook.test.ts — AC4 Agent judge-class reject (+allow in non-judge); AC5 3rd path deny→abort, 21st phase deny→hiccup; AC6 every allow+deny→audit row (tool,path,namespace,decision); WebFetch/WebSearch fetch rows; Bash multi-token.
- audit.test.ts — buffering, flush, auto-flush at flushAt, append-only re-buffer on transport failure, RETENTION_DAYS=90.
- subagents.test.ts — renderAllowedPaths; inheritForSubagent scoped (Read-only + narrowed mounts + attribution) and plain (inherit).

Decision recorded: §12.6 fine-grained mount tables encoded as SEAT_MOUNTS in @rhema/hooks (path globs the coarse
agent_types namespace tokens cannot express — preferences.md visibility, per-seat persona-file subsets). P0.02
code-seed left unchanged (its comment delegates this refinement to P0.05/P0.06). Bash write-via-redirect to a
seat-readable-but-read-only path is classified read (allowed) here and caught by the kernel read-only bind mount
(§11.5 REQ-DATA-5) + write-back layer (§12.2) — documented defense-in-depth, not a hook gap.

## Independent review (Phase 3/4) — findings closed
Fresh-context reviewer found 5 majors + minors; all confirmed and fixed (re-review clean; +10 tests):
- F1 (major, wall) realpath defeated by pre-collapsing `..` → classifyPath now hands the UNCOLLAPSED path to
  the resolver, normalizes after (paths.ts). Test: symlink-parent+`..` → author ns → deny.
- F2/F7 (major/minor) command-chaining + multi-path recursive bypass → splitBashCommands + per-subcommand,
  all positional paths checked (paths.ts). Tests added.
- F3 (major) calibrator allow-after-prediction unreachable (serverFetchDisabled short-circuit) → evaluateUrl
  gains `viaFetcher`; server WebFetch stays denied, the client-fetcher path reaches the allow rule (url-policy.ts).
  AC3 tests rewritten to the spec-real config (serverFetchDisabled:true + viaFetcher).
- F4 (major, hold-out) query-string evasion → hold-out/exclusion matching now on scheme+host+PATH ignoring
  query (url-policy.ts pathKey). Test: `?d=<exfil>` appended → deny.
- F5 (major) tool-set compiled but unenforced → tool-set gate in evaluateToolUse keyed on capability tokens
  (hook.ts TOOL_TOKEN). Bash intentionally ungated (path+kernel). Tests added.
- F8 (minor) Glob/Grep pattern `..` escape → denied. F9 scoped-subagent tokens fixed to ["read"] (gate now
  denies its Write/WebFetch/Agent; "no Bash" delegated to mount+SDK per §12.6). Nit: REQ-OBJ-8 citation fixed.
- F6 (minor) WebSearch not URL-checked: WebSearch is now tool-set gated; query-level exfil is the proxy's
  §12.8(d) job (out of scope here) — documented, accepted.

- 5.1 unit + 5.2 integration: `pnpm vitest run packages/hooks` → 6 files, 81 tests pass. Full hook driven

  seat-tables.test.ts. Whole repo: `pnpm vitest run` → 42 files, 316 tests pass (no regressions).
- Green gate: `pnpm turbo build lint typecheck` → 78 tasks successful.
- 5.3 live/interactive: N/A — @rhema/hooks is a pure policy library with no deployable runtime surface; the
